title: Billionaire B – “B.L.O.W (Freestyle)
htmlContent: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O3kMEaAtspQ&feature=youtu.be   Billionaire B is no longer wondering, “where have you been,“ instead he comes back today with a fresh new freestyle and accompanying visual in the physique of “B.L.O.W.” The latest follows up April’s long awaited release “Where Have You Been” featuring the electric Canadian recording artist that is Noah aka No1. To catch all the action in the new visual “B.L.O.W” director and Vancouver native JoshuLap Laptop, catches Billi on a cinematic journey through time with clips of  some of the things he loves to do the most, on the road doing shows, smoking big blunts, enjoying the company of beautiful women in his condo and counting cash (of course his name is Billionaire). More on the specifics of what life is like for Billionaire B, he composed a whole album about it and calling it YALETOWN. No word on a date, but be on the outlook for the aforementioned project, which is slated to release later this year.
